name: Hartley-Hartley Tangent Vector Formula
aliases: Householder formula for tangential vector orthogonalization
definition: A method to compute tangent and bitangent vectors for splat orientation that uses an isotropic radius, considering only the direction and sense of the local normal vector, not point density.
summary: The Hartley-Hartley Tangent Vector Formula computes tangent and bitangent vectors from a surface normal using Householder reflections, offering a computationally efficient, non-shape-aware alternative to the Covariance Matrix technique for point cloud rendering.
